purpose: The corpus every hosted R and S lens is fitted on: drowse's own `lens fit` (fit_lens) over the dequantized browser weights in fp32, 64 documents of 128 tokens after the first 16, both sites, every layer (B2-fits.md). No corpus text is redistributed; the packs carry fitted matrices and token counts.
